name: The mind turned inward too long

props.ChoiceTitle: The mind turned inward too long
props.ChoiceText: What began as private reflection deepened into such inwardness that when you finally spoke again, your thoughts seemed to come from far below the ordinary level of conversation.
props.ChoiceBio: You learned that inwardness can deepen insight while making return to common company more difficult.

2.TargetText: Someone still remembers how changed your speech sounded after so long alone with your thoughts.

0.Amount: You learned that the mind does not always come back from its inward journeys speaking in ordinary tones.
